summary: Iteration 11 — validated 3 new features end-to-end: (1) Global leaderboard API + page, (2) game_type exposed on public contests + 🎮 Play to win badge, (3) Admin bulk launch/pause endpoints and UI. All 15 new pytest cases in tests/test_leaderboard_and_bulk.py PASSED (2.16s). Frontend Playwright validation confirmed every data-testid requested in the review: global-leaderboard-page, leaderboard-tabs, tab-global, 3 tab-contest-<id> tabs, podium, global-row-1, contest-board on click, Leaderboard nav link → /leaderboard, 7 play-to-win-badge-<id> on Home + 3 on /competitions, bulk-actions-bar with bulk-launch-btn/bulk-pause-btn on /admin/games (counters 3 live / 0 on hold / 3 total; toast 'All game contests launched — 3 contests updated'), and bulk-launch-contests-btn / bulk-pause-contests-btn on /admin/competitions (labelled 'Hold all'). Auth guard: pytest confirms unauthenticated POST to /api/admin/contests/bulk/{launch,pause} → 401/403. Global leaderboard has non-empty data (podium + rows visible). No mocks. No regressions observed.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_routes.py L271 `payload: dict | None` without = None default — FastAPI will require a body. Works because all callers send {}, but signature should be `payload: dict | None = None` to be safe if a bare POST comes in. Currently the frontend always sends a JSON body so it does not break.

game_routes.py L150 `db.game_scores.aggregate(...).to_list(int(limit))` — Motor will still emit all pipeline results into memory before the limit is applied; the $limit stage inside the pipeline handles it correctly, so no bug. OK.

GlobalLeaderboard.jsx L20 sets up a 15s setInterval that only reloads the global rows — the per-contest board (ContestBoard) has its own 15s interval. Two intervals firing per page load is fine, but consider consolidating.

GlobalLeaderboard.jsx L85 `p.total_points.toLocaleString()` — if a future API returns `null` for total_points this will throw. Consider `(p.total_points || 0).toLocaleString()`. Low risk right now since aggregation always yields a number.
contest_routes.py `_to_public` correctly surfaces `game_type` (may be null). Good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all data-testid selectors present and clickable; toast + counters update after bulk actions)

seed_data_creation: None. Test relies on the 3 pre-seeded contests (memory_match, number_sequence, emoji_riddle) mentioned by main agent. bulk/launch relaunches them at the end of the test so subsequent runs / UI checks continue to see them as live.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bulk endpoint fixtures: tests deliberately launch → verify → pause → verify → relaunch to leave DB in a good state (game contests live). If you re-run pytest, expect matched/updated to be 0 on the first bulk/launch(only_games,draft) if all 3 game contests are already live — this is treated as success per main agent's spec. To run new regression: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_leaderboard_and_bulk.py -v`. Global leaderboard has existing game_scores data so /api/leaderboard/global returns non-empty. Frontend data-testids validated: global-leaderboard-page, leaderboard-tabs, tab-global, tab-contest-<id>, podium, global-row-<rank>, contest-board, contest-row-<rank>, play-to-win-badge-<id>, bulk-actions-bar, bulk-launch-btn, bulk-pause-btn, bulk-launch-contests-btn, bulk-pause-contests-btn.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration.
